In August 2020, I started the NotaAnota project. The goal was to put into practice what I've learned in world of Android development, applying new concepts and technologies. 

Since then, I have maintained it and occasionally publishing updates on Play Store. 

Below, you will find a timeline describing technical aspects, improvements, new features and refactorings that I have been developing in the app over the years. 
Where to find me: Tarsila Costalonga
- Massive update of project dependencies; \n\n- Migration from DataBinding to ViewBinding in all fragments.
- Start of Compose migration: initial configurations and theme definition.
- New feature: sketch. Now, when leaving the screen or closing the app, when you come back to the add note screen, you can choose between continuing where you left off or start a fresh note.
- Gradle migration from groove to kts; \n\n- Migration from dependency management to version catalog.
- Redesigning About screen: display all the work done within the app in a timeline format.
